name: Nemean Games
summary: The biennial crown games of Zeus at Nemea — founded, the Theban saga says, when the Seven buried the infant Opheltes as Archemorus and first ran and wrestled beside his grave.
testimonia: Apollodorus, Bibliotheca 3.6.4 (the Seven found the Nemean games for Opheltes/Archemorus)
Pausanias 2.15.2–3 (the grove of Nemean Zeus and the grave of Opheltes)
Calendar note: no baked Nemean peak yet — Olympics alone use olympicPeak in the Attic reconstruction; Nemea still awaits its own cycle anchor (not faked with annual conventionalDates)
